title: Aircraft Dispatch Evidence Gate
tagline: An inoperative item is not dispatchable because a similar airplane once flew without it.

cards: The same item was deferred before
Fleet memory makes dispatch look routine.
Approval is aircraft and operation specific
The exact MEL, operations specification and limitation bind the answer.
A non-deferrable item enters a release packet.
The packet advances only as a candidate for dispatcher/PIC control.

story.headline: The familiar MEL item on the wrong airplane
beats: A departure has one inoperative instrument and a narrowing slot.
A similar aircraft previously flew under an MEL deferral.
The agent transfers that memory despite a different approved record.
The evidence firewall holds the aircraft and routes joint operational control.
